description: This script generates a version file for PyTorch by extracting version information from environment variables, Git or Mercurial repositories, and local files, and writes metadata including version, debug status, and optional hardware versions.

methods.name: get_sha
methods.description: Retrieves the current commit SHA from Git or Mercurial repositories in the specified directory.

methods.name: get_tag
methods.description: Retrieves the current Git tag if it matches a release pattern.

methods.name: get_torch_version
methods.description: Determines the PyTorch version string based on environment variables, PKG-INFO, version.txt, and Git commit SHA.
